item: Zonal Lumped model: a footprint over a dense via group is split into the core of the vias and the rest, with a 0.5 mm Lumped raster for the board
why: plate_vias (a 4 x 4 array of 16 vias under the pad of U) is the only board of the suite with a zoned part: the Lumped maximum falls from 140.3555 to 136.4534 degC at the 1 and 2 mm settings (-3.90 K, the zones at 0.5 mm with the cluster well kept, cap) and from 140.1495 at 0.5 mm (-3.70 K); the field checksums move with the 0.5 mm raster and the core painted with its node; the time to 63 % of U moves from 27.83 to 31.00 s. Every other record is bit-identical (the one-node network is the program's code).
